title: Population Stability Index for Feature Drift
hints: The bin edges come from the reference window only. Refitting them on today's data hides the drift you are looking for.
Interior edges are np.quantile(reference, [1/n, 2/n, ..., (n-1)/n]). Collapse repeated edges with np.unique before binning.
Bins are right-closed: np.searchsorted(edges, x, side='left') gives the bin of x. Floor each proportion at eps before taking the log.
